title: Rust Ed25519 KYA Mandate Signer/Verifier & RFC 9421 Signature Engine
description: Implement Ed25519 cryptographic mandate signing & verification (API-01, API-02), RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth signature verification, and PayPal Webhook CRC32 + signature verifier (API-04) in Rust.
steps: Implement KyaMandate struct and Ed25519 sign/verify functions using ed25519-dalek and sha2
Enforce budget ceiling (max_amount_cents), category allowlist, max_spread_bps, and expiry_utc
Implement PayPal webhook CRC32 checksum verification using crc32fast
Write unit tests for valid mandates, tampered amounts, and expired mandates
pass: cargo test mandate passes in services/firewall-rs
